Hi Anna —

Great speaking earlier. Attaching a marked-up Order Form (MSA + Order Form redlines) and the Coupa field matrix that our onboarding team needs filled before we can activate your supplier record. Two items to confirm so we can keep the July activation window: 

1) PO number format and SKU normalization: MediCore issues POs with a 12-digit PO number and a free-form SKU field. Our Coupa acceptance requires a consistent SKU key (vendor SKU or Redwood prod_sku) to map line items for automated invoicing. If you can provide a mapping file or confirm vendor SKU usage, ops can complete the Coupa profile.

2) Identity & tax attributes: We need a Supplier Tax ID (EIN) and the legal entity name exactly as shown on invoices. If you have an in-house vendor ID in Coupa or a ProcureSys vendor record, please share the ID to avoid duplicate supplier creation.

Action items from our side: Marissa and Legal will review the Order Form redlines and propose language for the PO acceptance clause (will send by EOD). Kimberly will validate field mapping and SFTP/EDI settings.

Attachments: redline_orderform_marked.pdf (tracked changes), coupa_field_matrix_v3.xlsx (template).

Proposed next steps:
- Anna: send back vendor SKU mapping or confirm the field to use by Wednesday 7/7.
- ProcureSys: confirm whether you will handle vendor ID population into Coupa once we provide the payload.
- Redwood: legal redline turnaround by EOD 7/1.

Thanks,

Anna / Sean —

Quick update from legal after an initial pass on redline_orderform_marked.pdf. High level: we can accept most procurement-side edits, but we need to tighten the PO acceptance and invoice reconciliation sections so automated matching doesn't create financial liability for Redwood if there is nonstandard SKU mapping. Proposed language (embedded as tracked changes in the attached PDF):
- Add clause: "Vendor SKU takes precedence for automated PO-item matching; any manual invoice adjustments required due to free-form SKU fields are the responsibility of the buyer (MediCore) unless Redwood's mapping payload contains inaccurate SKU values."
- Data retention: limit logs retained per the Legal/Privacy playbook (90 days telemetry; invoice artifacts retained per the Order Form for archiving purposes).
- Indemnity redline: we revised the mutual indemnity to carve out aggregated telemetry and non-personal billing metadata.

Please review the tracked changes. If MediCore accepts the PO-matching precedence clause, we can keep automation enabled and proceed with Coupa activation. If not, ops will mark the vendor for manual invoice reconciliation which will delay automated invoicing.

Marissa

Ops notes: thanks for the sample mapping, Anna. Two quick items from integration: 
1) ProcureSys vendor ID PSY-4472 is sufficient to prevent duplicate supplier records; we'll use that as the primary key for the Coupa payload.
2) For free-form SKU fallbacks we support a three-tier matching cascade: vendor_sku -> internal_sku -> fuzzy_text_match. Fuzzy matches will be flagged for manual review and will not auto-finalize payment until an exception is cleared. That means if MediCore wants fully automated invoicing, please provide vendor_sku or internal_sku for >95% of SKUs.

Technical ask: please upload the full mapping file to the Drive link (I gave in the HubSpot note) and confirm SFTP/EDI window for file pickups (we prefer daily midnight UTC).

I can begin populating the Coupa profile once Marissa confirms redline language. If legal accepts the precedence clause, we will flip the automation switch and run a dry-run with two test POs.
